summary: FAZ 2 follow-ups verified end-to-end via Playwright against the public URL. (1) '📷 Fotoğraflı' quick-filter tab present in template gallery (data-testid=tpl-cat-photo); clicking it renders photo-filter-note and lists exactly the 4 photo templates (tpl-card-wed-photo, tpl-card-eng-photo, tpl-card-kina-photo, tpl-card-sun-photo) with non-photo templates (e.g., tpl-card-wed-botanic) excluded. (2) Photo-upload-tip (dikey 3:4 uyarısı) appears when a photo template is active (tpl-use-kina-photo) and disappears after selecting a non-photo template (tpl-use-wed-botanic). Cover-crop-preview markup is in place (would render after upload). (3) Live preview label syncs with template category: kina-photo → 'KINA GECESİ', wed-botanic → 'DÜĞÜN', eng-pastel → 'NİŞAN', kina-bordo → 'KINA GECESİ'. (4) Guest page /davetiye/elif-kaan-173c7b now shows 'KINA GECESİ' (previously 'DÜĞÜN' cosmetic bug fixed via eventLabelFor preferring template category). Regression /davetiye/ahmet-yasemin-9a66eb still renders 'KINA GECESİ' with RSVP form present and no console errors (401s are the unauthenticated /api/member/me probe — expected).

issues: Radix Dialog missing Description/aria-describedby — accessibility warning in console (non-blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: eventLabelFor correctly prioritises template.category over stored event_type — fixes 'DÜĞÜN on kına template' cosmetic bug for existing invitations without DB migration.
photoTemplates() filters via t.photo flag — cleanly reuses INVITATION_TEMPLATES.
Consider adding aria-describedby / DialogDescription to <DialogContent> for a11y (Radix warning).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only FAZ 2 follow-ups (photo tab, photo-upload-tip, 3:4 crop preview markup, eventLabelFor category-driven label). All four acceptance criteria pass on the preview URL. Guest slugs elif-kaan-173c7b and ahmet-yasemin-9a66eb both display 'KINA GECESİ'. Only non-blocking Radix a11y warning observed.
